_comment: A voice = voice-cloning reference + sampling seed. 'ref' is a clip from the model repo (samples/...) or a path next to this file. 'bootstrap' makes the reference once with the model itself (no reference, fixed seed) and caches the codes in $LANI_VOICE_STATE/voices/. 'aliases' are extra speaker names. Any other speaker name maps to a fixed voice from the 'pool' (crc32 of the name).

bootstrap.text: Danes je lep sončen dan in ptice pojejo na drevesih.
